quiz.question: Which language dominates data science and artificial intelligence?
quiz.explanation: Python is the go-to language for data science and AI thanks to its simple syntax and enormous ecosystem of ready-made libraries.

quiz.question: Why is Python so popular for working with data?

answers.answer: It is the only language the CPU can understand
It has simple syntax and a huge collection of pre-built tools
It runs faster than every other language
It was designed exclusively for spreadsheets

quiz.explanation: Python's approachable syntax lowers the barrier to entry, and its massive library ecosystem means you rarely have to build things from scratch.
